notes: Targeted searches for Arhangay/Arkhangai with data center, datacenter, server farm, colocation, cloud, and Mongolian дата төв terms found no verified physical data center project or facility in the province. Mongolia-wide evidence points to data-center activity concentrated around Ulaanbaatar.

name: Mongolian National Data Center
developer: Mongolian National Data Center / Government of Mongolia
notes: Official MNDC page says the government-funded National Data Center was established by Government Resolution No. 183 on June 24, 2009 and operates national electronic data systems; OpenDataLab lists the entity address in Songinokhairkhan district, Ulaanbaatar.

name: Bank of Mongolia NETC Main Data Center
developer: Bank of Mongolia / National Electronic Transaction Center
notes: Bank of Mongolia announced completion of the NETC main data center and Tier II award; Uptime Institute lists Main Data Center of National Electronic Transaction Center in Ulaanbaatar with Tier II design certification.

name: Khan Bank Primary Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute awards list shows Khan Bank Primary Data Center in Ulaanbaatar, Bayanzurkh District with Tier II Certification of Design Documents and Tier II Certification of Constructed Facility.

name: Khan Bank Seoul Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute awards list shows Khan Bank Seoul Data Center in Ulaanbaatar, Sukhbaatar District with Tier II design, constructed-facility, and Silver operational sustainability certifications.

name: Khan Bank Technical Center-1
notes: Uptime Institute awards list shows Khan Bank Technical Center-1 in Ulaanbaatar with Tier III Certification of Design Documents and Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility.

name: XacBank Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute awards list shows XacBank Data Center in Ulaanbaatar with Tier II Certification of Design Documents and Tier II Certification of Constructed Facility.

name: S Systems Data Center
notes: Shunkhlai Holding's official page says it launched a project to build Mongolia's largest data center and established S Systems Data Center in 2022; RackCorp and DCD identify S Systems as a Ulaanbaatar data-center operator.

name: Mogul Data Center
notes: ColocationM lists Mogul Data Center on Zuunmod Rd, HUD 21 Khoroo, Ulaanbaatar, established in 2021 by Mogul Service LLC with Tier 3-compliant colocation; RackCorp also lists Mogul DC as a Ulaanbaatar colocation facility.

name: Gemnet Data Center
notes: RackCorp's Mongolia datacenter page lists Gemnet DC as a Ulaanbaatar datacenter facility providing backbone, colocation, and IP transit services.

name: Unitel Data Center
notes: DCD reports Mongolia has a local telco Unitel data center in Ulaanbaatar; Data Center Map lists Unitel Data Center on Viva City Rd and describes colocation services.

name: Mobinet Ulaanbaatar Data Center
notes: Mobinet's official page advertises data-center services; DCD notes Newcomm Group's Mobinet claims facilities in Mongolia, and Datacenters.com lists a Mobicom/Mobinet Ulaanbaatar data center at 28 UNESCO Street.

name: Cloudflare Ulaanbaatar Edge Data Center
notes: Cloudflare announced Ulaanbaatar as city 154 on its network in 2018, stating it had deployed a data center in Ulaanbaatar after securing a local secure data-center site and bandwidth partner; physical host facility and capacity were not disclosed.

name: ICT Group JSC Tier III data centre
notes: Haskoning project page says ICT Group JSC was opening a new Tier III-standard data centre in Mongolia in 2022 and already operated two data centres; DCD later referred to ICT Group as previously developing a facility. Public sources reviewed did not confirm current operating status or a more specific city location, but Mongolia's market evidence is concentrated around Ulaanbaatar.
